 Opinion Eyes wide open: Arizona seniors should review their Medicare coverage now
 Valley physician: Advantage plans can change significantly; don’t let open enrollment pass without confirming critical features
 Dr. Leo Odle 
 Submitted photo/Optum – Arizona 
 OPINION — Medicare’s Annual Enrollment Period  runs Oct. 15 through Dec. 7, giving people with Medicare an opportunity to sign up for a plan, review existing coverage and make changes for the coming year.
 As a primary care physician, I see how Medicare plan choices can affect patients long after enrollment ends. A plan that looks good on paper may not fit how you actually use health care.
 As you review Medicare options for 2027, here are five mistakes to avoid.
